description_en: Executes evaluation rules to perform compliance pre-checks on resources
description_zh: 执行预检规则对资源进行合规预检
name: EvaluatePreConfigRules

fields.help_en:

fields.help_zh:
资源逻辑ID。

如果该参数为空，则按照`ResourceProperties`的Base64位生成
fields.name: resource_logical_id

fields.help_en:
The resource configuration items (properties of the resource to be created), such as the specifications, region, name, status, and port or network interface switch status of the resource.

The `ResourceType`, `Identifier`, and `ResourceProperties` parameters must be specified at the same time
fields.help_zh:
资源配置项（即将创建的资源属性），例如：资源的规格、所属地域、名称、状态、端口或网口开关状态等。

参数`ResourceType`、`Identifier`和`ResourceProperties`必须同时设置
fields.name: resource_properties

资源类型。

fields.help_zh:
规则标识。

true: enables rule templates.

false (default): does not enable rule templates

Annotation.description_en: The reason why the resource was evaluated as incompliant

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance type of the resource that was evaluated by using the evaluation rule. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource is evaluated as compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The resource is evaluated as non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resource
ComplianceType.description_zh:
预检规则的合规类型。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用
